rows.en: ＊Riko＊＠１０８＿００３Oh, morning!￥Are you on your way￥to training right now?
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿００４I'm thinking of the Flight￥Training Room today. Why don't￥you come there too?
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿００５Heh, with me around, we'll￥get tons done, you know?!￥Come on, let's go!
＊Riko＊＠１０８＿００６Oh... Well, everyone has￥days like that!￥I'll just go by myself, then...
